decisions.seriesBoundaryEvidence: TCDB, Beckett set info and DA Card World agree 441/452; BaseballCardPedia prose says 442/451. Use 441/452.
decisions.physicalWaxFormat: 16 baseball cards plus 1 World Series Magic Motion trivia card; 36 packs per box.
decisions.vcsPackFormat: 17 total slots so guaranteed trivia leaves 16 base slots normally. Other insert hits replace another base slot.
decisions.hotRookiesConversion: One per 100-base-card blister pack. 100/16=6.25 wax equivalents; rounded to 1:6 VCS packs. Intentional channel approximation, not historical wax odds.
decisions.mantleOdds: Published estimated Series Two ratios 1:1942 unsigned and 1:30000 autograph; combine using 452/893 Series Two weight: round(1942*893/452)=3837 and round(30000*893/452)=59270. These are derived approximations, not guaranteed manufacturer box odds.
decisions.variations: Four extra source variation/error rows collapse to canonical corrected/later b states.
decisions.exclusions: Cooperstown factory-set bonus, Mickey Mantle Glossy dealer/media promo, base promos and separate boxed/Rookie-Traded products excluded.
decisions.teamExceptions: American Flag #737 and 16 World Series Q&A trivia cards have no team. Intentionally blank; current importer requires --allow-pending-teams.
decisions.autographPrintRun: Signed checklist has seven subjects with 356 per subject/2500 aggregate numbering. Preserve as metadata without claiming 2500 copies of each subject.
